warning: Published references and matched development results are separate comparison classes and must not be merged into one score.

atmem_prior_checkpoint.qualification: The run is valid for its retained checkpoint, but the checkpoint predates the latest formation replay and omits known answer-bearing source states. It is not the latest-implementation baseline.

atmem_latest.qualification: Official pinned 3% development slice before the current evidence-navigation iteration; retained as the latest paid baseline, not as a claim for the unscored v5 candidate.

atmem_enterprise_iteration.qualification: Same frozen enterprise questions and checkpoint. Bounded runs use a 4096-token completion ceiling with reader thinking disabled, so they are not strict matches to the 20000-token baseline. The 4/7 peak did not reproduce: confirmation was 3/7.

agentrunbook_c.reason: The pinned harness selected a model unsupported by the installed ChatGPT OAuth Codex client. A one-question compatible-default preflight completed but missed the answer and is not a scored matched run.

published_mem0_slice.system: Mem0 hosted with Hermes and GPT 5.6 Luna

mem0_oss_matched.reason: No hosted Mem0 credential is available; the open-source engine must be run and labeled separately.

targets.rule: Reach parity with the strongest matched reference first, then at least 10 percent relative improvement while also reporting absolute percentage-point delta.
